normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, hitting twice. The first hit damages opposing Pokémon with a normal basic attack; the second hit is a follow-up attack with a bone, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area a second time and throwing them for 0.5s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Aura Cannon
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and channels aura into a huge sphere, then launches the sphere in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The aura sphere picks up speed as it travels; at close range, a target can be hit up to 4 times, while at max speed a target will only be hit once. After unleashing this move the user mega evolves for 25s adding additional effects to Close Combat and Power-Up Punch and changing the passive ability to Adaptability. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
